name: v2-large
note: Production scale (SYSTEM.md 2.2: 'start d512 / 6+6 / ~40M; epochs and params are NOT economized'). Differs from base.json ONLY in d_model, layer counts and ff — same data, same schedule, same features, same heads, same f14 exclusion — so large-vs-base is a clean scale comparison. If it diverges early, the fix is a second run with a longer warmup, not an edit to this file.

model._pos: sinusoidal here too: rope would be a second variable on top of the size change. Flip it in a third config once this run has a curve to compare against.
model._exclude_features: f14 = pedal_state, also the fourth head target — see base.json.

train._schedule: Byte-identical to base.json's train block. A 45M model would usually get a lower LR and a longer warmup, but changing them here would make every difference from base attributable to two causes at once. The grad-norm clip at 1.0 is the safety net; watch the first 300 steps.
